label: s1_side02_0020_camera_01
text: OK, kiddo! Time for me to take a perfect shot—\nat your confidence, that is!\c\nReady to show me what you’ve got?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_02
text: Really? How about just a photo shoot, then?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_03
text: Yes! Then let’s just put a bit of distance between\nus—enough to keep my shots in focus...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_04
text: I’m not so strong, but don’t hold back! And don’t\nmind me snapping a few shots while we’re at it![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_05
text: You’re something, all right. I got a buncha good\nshots of you in action, too.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_06
text: I think you just might have what it takes to hold\nyour own against the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Bloodmoon Beast[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_select_01
text: The Bloodmoon Beast?

label: s1_side02_0020_select_02
text: Is that the Pokémon you’re after?

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_07
text: Yeah. There’s a certain Ursaluna I’ve been\nsearching for...\c\nIt’s known as the Bloodmoon Beast.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_08
text: Have you ever heard of Ursaluna? Word is they\nweren’t all that uncommon a long, long time ago.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_09
text: See, Ursaluna is a Pokémon that usually has this\nbig yellow mark on its forehead resembling a full\r\nmoon—but they say this one’s mark is red...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_10
text: A red moon, as if seen through a veil of blood...\c\nThat’s why they call it the Bloodmoon Beast.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_11
text: This Ursaluna—the Bloodmoon Beast—used to\nlive in my homeland waaay back when people\r\nstill called the region Hisui.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_12
text: Seems like it crossed over the waters here to\nKitakami at some point and made itself comfy.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_13
text: If the two of us work together, I bet we could be\nthe ones to finally find and snap a shot of it.\r\nAnd if we do...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_14
text: Kiddo!\c\nNo, not “kiddo”—partner![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_15
text: Let’s tackle this together, so we can find the\nBloodmoon Beast for sure![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_select_03
text: Let’s do it!

label: s1_side02_0020_select_04
text: I don’t know...

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_16
text: I knew you’d be up for it! And don’t worry—I’ll\nbe sure to reward your hard work.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_17
text: Aw, don’t be like that! I’ll even reward you for\nthe effort you put in![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_18
text: Word has it the Bloodmoon Beast has been seen\nin an area northeast of Oni Mountain called the\r\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Timeless Woods[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_19
text: I’ll head that way now and wait for you there![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_camera_20
text: Come on, Growlithe![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0020_dog_01
text: Grawaaan!
